purpose: Semantic layer / harness for grounding an LLM over the Ballast thermal-power digital-twin database. Describes tables, grains, join graph, source systems, and the ₹ metric formulas so the model can write correct SQL and never hallucinate structure.

conventions.time_high_res: High-volume time-series columns named `ts` are INTEGER Unix epoch SECONDS (UTC). Convert to IST by adding tz_offset_seconds (19800). In SQL: datetime(ts+19800,'unixepoch').
conventions.time_daily: Daily/reference tables use TEXT ISO date `date` = 'YYYY-MM-DD' and `month` = 'YYYY-MM'.
conventions.now: Current sim time = data_meta['clock_now'] (epoch). The DB is anchored to 2026-07-04 08:00 IST; do not use wall-clock now().
conventions.money: All ₹ amounts are in rupees. Divide by 1e7 for crore (Cr).
conventions.prefer_rollups: For KPIs/₹, query the daily rollup tables (performance_kpi, commitments, commercial_exposure) and views — NOT raw telemetry. Raw telemetry is only for single-tag time-series charts (filter by tag_id + ts range).

source_systems.DCS/HIST: Distributed Control System + Historian (Emerson Ovation, OSIsoft/AVEVA PI). Feeds: telemetry, telemetry_1min, condition_monitoring, unit_operating_state, emissions, ambient_weather.
source_systems.CMMS: Maintenance/EAM (SAP PM, IBM Maximo). Feeds: equipment, work_orders, outage_events, reliability_metrics, spares_inventory, equipment_spares, purchase_orders.
source_systems.COMM: Commercial/Scheduling/Market (RLDC/SLDC, REMC, IEX/PXIL). Feeds: commitments, schedule_blocks, commercial_exposure, tariff_components, market_prices, beneficiaries, fuel_stock.
source_systems.BALLAST: Ballast's own AI/agentic outputs. Feeds: failure_predictions, alerts, data_meta.

grounding_standards.ISO_14224: equipment taxonomy (system/subsystem/equipment_class) + failure_mode/failure_mechanism vocabulary (equipment, failure_modes tables).
grounding_standards.NERC_GADS_IEEE_762: availability/reliability metrics EAF/EFOR/EFORd + outage event classes (reliability_metrics, outage_events.gads_event_type).
grounding_standards.CERC_ABT_2024: availability-based tariff: capacity charge recovery vs NAPAF, DSM (units.napaf_pct, units.afc_cr_per_year, commercial_exposure).
grounding_standards.CEA_PAT: performance norms: station heat rate, PLF, aux consumption, specific coal (performance_kpi).

metric_formulas.capacity_charge_recovery: Per CERC: Capacity Charge = AFC × 0.5 × (NDM/NDY) × (PAFM/NAPAF). Full recovery requires PAF ≥ NAPAF. If PAF < NAPAF, recovery is pro-rated -> under-recovery = the penalty. Stored daily in commercial_exposure.capacity_charge_lost_inr.
metric_formulas.net_exposure: commercial_exposure.net_exposure_inr = capacity_charge_lost_inr + dsm_charge_inr + rtm_replacement_cost_inr. The single ₹ number Ballast optimizes down.
metric_formulas.dsm_charge: Deviation Settlement: penalty for under-injecting vs schedule, priced off grid frequency / exchange (commercial_exposure.dsm_charge_inr).
metric_formulas.rtm_replacement: When a unit is derated/tripped it buys shortfall energy on IEX Real-Time Market at a premium (commercial_exposure.rtm_replacement_cost_inr, exchange_price_inr_mwh).
metric_formulas.health_index: condition_monitoring.health_index 0..100 (100 healthy). Derived from vibration (ISO 10816: 4.5 alert, 7.1 danger) and bearing temperature.
metric_formulas.eaf_efor: reliability_metrics: EAF = equivalent availability factor; EFOR/EFORd = equivalent forced outage rate (demand) per IEEE 762.

tables.name: data_meta
tables.desc: Clock/now pointer + generation metadata. Read clock_now for current time.

tables.name: plants
tables.desc: Generating stations.

tables.name: units
tables.desc: Generating units. Holds napaf_pct + afc_cr_per_year that drive all ₹ math.

tables.name: equipment
tables.desc: ISO 14224 taxonomy. standby_equip_id encodes redundancy (used to detect 'no healthy standby'). monitored=1 streams condition data.

tables.name: failure_modes
tables.desc: ISO 14224 failure-mode/mechanism reference per equipment_class.

tables.name: process_tags
tables.desc: Tag catalog. tier='both' tags also exist at 1-min. Join to telemetry via tag_id.

tables.name: telemetry
tables.desc: Full-history rollup for trend charts. Filter by tag_id + ts range.

tables.name: telemetry_1min
tables.desc: High-res raw for the live twin + vibration zoom. Live ticker appends here.

tables.name: condition_monitoring
tables.desc: Vibration/bearing/health per rotating asset. Use v_equipment_health_now for latest.

tables.name: unit_operating_state
tables.desc: Load/state/frequency. state in {running,derated,tripped,reserve_shutdown,planned_outage,startup}.

tables.name: emissions
tables.desc: CEMS: SOx/NOx/SPM/CO2/O2/stack temp (mg/Nm3).

tables.name: ambient_weather
tables.desc: Ambient temp/humidity/CW inlet (affects condenser vacuum & output).

tables.name: performance_kpi
tables.desc: PLF, PAF, station heat rate, aux %, specific coal, efficiency. Primary source for KPI charts.

tables.name: work_orders
tables.desc: Maintenance orders (preventive/breakdown/predictive). status in {open,in_progress,completed,scheduled}. Golden: BFP-2C has an in_progress breakdown WO (standby down).

tables.name: outage_events
tables.desc: GADS-classed events (forced/planned/maintenance/derating) with cause codes + mwh_lost.

tables.name: reliability_metrics
tables.desc: EAF/EFOR/EFORd/MTBF/MTTR/trips per IEEE 762.

tables.name: failure_predictions
tables.desc: Ballast AI output: predicted_failure_date, rul_days, confidence, recommended_action, rupees_at_risk. The golden BFP-2A prediction lives here.

tables.name: alerts
tables.desc: Live alert/notification stream the twin surfaces. Use v_active_alerts. Severity critical/warning/info; rupees_at_risk on commercial alerts.

tables.name: spares_inventory
tables.desc: Critical spares w/ on_hand_qty + lead_time_days. Golden: SP-BRG-BFP-THR on_hand=0, lead_time=14d.

tables.name: equipment_spares
tables.desc: Which spare each equipment needs (many-to-many).

tables.name: purchase_orders
tables.desc: Incoming spares w/ eta + status. Golden: PO-2026-3391 for the bearing arrives ~12d out (too late).

tables.name: fuel_stock
tables.desc: Coal stock, days_of_coal (<4 critical), GCV, moisture, ash, cost. Secondary scenario: CSTPS ~3.4 days now.

tables.name: commitments
tables.desc: declared_capacity_mw vs scheduled_mwh vs actual_mwh + PAF. 'Run closer to capacity' moves declared_capacity_mw.

tables.name: schedule_blocks
tables.desc: Intraday scheduled vs actual MW (dispatch profile chart).

tables.name: commercial_exposure
tables.desc: THE ₹ table. capacity_charge_lost_inr + dsm_charge_inr + rtm_replacement_cost_inr = net_exposure_inr. Use v_exposure_90d for totals.

tables.name: tariff_components
tables.desc: AFC breakdown (RoE/depreciation/interest/O&M/WC) for waterfall.

tables.name: market_prices
tables.desc: IEX clearing prices ₹/MWh (price curve chart).

tables.name: beneficiaries
tables.desc: PPA allocations: who buys the unit's power (allocation pie).

views.v_equipment_health_now: latest condition + health per monitored asset (with redundancy/standby).
views.v_exposure_90d: 90-day ₹ exposure totals per unit (Cr), split by cause.
views.v_active_alerts: active alerts, severity-ordered, with equipment name.

golden_scenario.story: Boiler Feed Pump 2A on VSTPS-U3 has rising vibration (~6.1 mm/s), predicted to fail in ~5 days. Its standby BFP-2C is out on maintenance (in_progress WO). The spare thrust bearing (SP-BRG-BFP-THR) is out of stock with 14-day lead; incoming PO arrives ~12 days out (too late). VSTPS-U3's PAF hovers just above NAPAF (83%), so a derating pushes it below -> capacity-charge under-recovery + DSM + RTM replacement. Projected exposure ≈ ₹4.76 Cr.
traversal: equipment_spares + spares_inventory + purchase_orders (spare stockout + late PO)

example_questions.q: Which equipment is closest to failure?
example_questions.sql: SELECT e.name,e.unit_id,cm.health_index,cm.vibration_mm_s FROM v_equipment_health_now cm JOIN equipment e USING(equip_id) ORDER BY cm.health_index ASC LIMIT 5;

example_questions.q: If BFP-2A trips, what's my rupee exposure?
example_questions.sql: SELECT equip_id,predicted_failure_date,rul_days,confidence_pct,rupees_at_risk/10000000.0 AS cr_at_risk,recommended_action FROM failure_predictions WHERE equip_id='VSTPS-U3-BFP-A';

example_questions.q: Does BFP-2A have a healthy standby?
example_questions.sql: SELECT e.equip_id,e.standby_equip_id,w.status AS standby_wo_status FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN work_orders w ON w.equip_id=e.standby_equip_id AND w.status IN('open','in_progress') WHERE e.equip_id='VSTPS-U3-BFP-A';

example_questions.q: Is the spare bearing in stock?
example_questions.sql: SELECT s.part_id,s.name,s.on_hand_qty,s.lead_time_days,p.po_id,p.eta FROM spares_inventory s LEFT JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.part_id=s.part_id WHERE s.part_id='SP-BRG-BFP-THR';

example_questions.q: How much have we lost to unplanned outages this quarter?
example_questions.sql: SELECT * FROM v_exposure_90d ORDER BY net_exposure_cr DESC;

example_questions.q: Show PAF vs NAPAF trend for VSTPS-U3
example_questions.sql: SELECT date,paf_pct FROM performance_kpi WHERE unit_id='VSTPS-U3' ORDER BY date;

example_questions.q: Which units are near an emission limit?
example_questions.sql: SELECT unit_id,AVG(nox_mg_nm3) nox FROM emissions WHERE ts>(SELECT CAST(value AS INT)-604800 FROM data_meta WHERE key='clock_now') GROUP BY unit_id ORDER BY nox DESC;
SELECT plant_id,days_of_coal,gcv_kcal_kg FROM fuel_stock WHERE date=(SELECT MAX(date) FROM fuel_stock);
